title: TTT in VLA Models: Exploring Training with Human Demonstrations
abstract: arXiv:2610.32094v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-horizon robot tasks require retaining and using past information. We integrate Test-Time Training (TTT), which stores context in fast weights, into InternVLA-A1 and Pi0.5 to study action generation conditioned on human demonstrations through training on paired demonstrations and robot trajectories. We implement memory transfer between the two phases and truncated backpropagation, and examine training objectives, gradient coverage, and contrastive regularization across video, short-video, and single-frame cue tasks. In our experiments, adding TTT and training on paired data at the current scale did not lead to consistent target selection based on demonstrations. Under the tested settings, shorter sequences, full trajectory gradient connectivity, and contrastive regularization did not clearly improve responsiveness to demonstrations. translated_title: VLA模型中的测试时训练（TTT）：探索基于人类演示的训练
translated_abstract: 长时程机器人任务需要保留并利用过去的信息。我们将测试时训练（TTT）——一种将上下文存储在快速权重中的方法——集成到 InternVLA-A1 和 Pi0.5 中，通过在配对的演示与机器人轨迹上进行训练，研究以人类演示为条件的动作生成。我们实现了两个阶段之间的记忆传递以及截断反向传播，并在视频、短视频和单帧线索任务中考察了训练目标、梯度覆盖范围和对比正则化。在我们的实验中，在当前规模下添加 TTT 并在配对数据上训练，并未实现基于演示的一致目标选择。在所测试的设置下，更短的序列、完整轨迹的梯度连接以及对比正则化并未明显提升对演示的响应性。当演示被简化为单帧线索时，真实机器人的执行仍然表现出偏好……
tldr: 该研究将测试时训练（TTT）集成到 InternVLA-A1 和 Pi0.5 两个VLA模型中，探索通过人类演示与机器人轨迹配对训练实现以演示为条件的动作生成，但发现在当前规模下该方法未能实现基于演示的一致目标选择，且各种改进策略均未带来明显提升。
en_tdlr: This work integrates Test-Time Training (TTT) into the VLA models InternVLA-A1 and Pi0.5 to explore action generation conditioned on human demonstrations through paired training of demonstrations and robot trajectories, but finds that at the current scale the approach fails to achieve consistent demonstration-based target selection, with various improvement strategies yielding no clear gains.
